ontology.name: Product Sales Knowledge Graph Base
ontology.purpose: Knowledge graph base for banking Product Catalog supporting Sale, Cross-sell, Upsell, Next Best Product and AI Sales Agent consumption.
ontology.compatibility: Superset of the supplied .ontology.json schema. Core keys classes/edges/attributes follow the sample; extra metadata preserves BA/FIBO/case-study evidence and relationship properties.

classes.name: product catalog
classes.label: product catalog
classes.definition: Semantic container representing the governed catalog of retail banking products and associated sales content.

businessMetadata.purpose: Provides the authoritative catalog boundary and common semantics for product information consumed by AI Sales Agent.

evidence.sourceQuote: Catalog là nơi tập trung quản lý toàn bộ sản phẩm bán lẻ (KHCN) của ngân hàng... Catalog cấp dữ liệu cho AI Sales Agent.

modeling.decisionReason: FIBO has an exact FinancialProductCatalog class, but the BA document primarily treats Catalog as a system/repository boundary. It is not required for recommendation traversal, so retain as an optional ontology root rather than forcing it into the operational graph.
modeling.openQuestions: Should Catalog be a queryable instance/root node, or only the system/ontology boundary?

fiboAlignment.definition: Catalog of financial products and/or services available for sale, with descriptions and product details.
fiboAlignment.reason: Semantic meaning aligns closely with the catalog described by BA. Retention as a graph node remains a business modeling choice, not a FIBO-driven requirement.

caseStudy.reference: CSV STT 7 — Semantic Knowledge Graph & Enterprise Ontology (Morgan Stanley) — Source: Semantic Arts Morgan Stanley Case Study (Semantic Arts); CSV STT 9 — Enterprise Loan Ontology / Single Customer Loan View (Sallie Mae) — Source: Semantic Arts Sallie Mae SOA Message Generation (Semantic Arts)
caseStudy.reusablePattern: Core ontology + domain ontology; ontology as canonical semantic contract.

classes.name: banking product
classes.label: banking product
classes.definition: A retail financial product managed in the catalog and made available for customer sale/advice, e.g. cards, loans, deposits, payment accounts, or attached insurance.

businessMetadata.purpose: Primary item being searched, sold, cross-sold, upsold, substituted, bundled and recommended.

evidence.sourceQuote: Quản lý vòng đời sản phẩm... thuộc tính, phân loại, giá, điều kiện bán, eligibility, chính sách.

modeling.decisionReason: Independent identity, lifecycle, many attributes, multiple inbound/outbound links, and central traversal target.
modeling.openQuestions: Which product attributes are universal vs product-type-specific? Is ProductCategory a managed taxonomy or a scalar classification?

fiboAlignment.definition: Financial-institution product provided to consumers or businesses.
fiboAlignment.reason: BA Product is specifically a retail banking/financial product. FIBO FinancialProduct is broader, so the local BankingProduct should specialize it rather than be treated as an exact class rename.

caseStudy.reference: CSV STT 1 — DBS Bank Knowledge Quotient & Customer 360 (DBS Bank) — https://neo4j.com/blog/financial-services/how-dbs-connect-knowledge-with-a-knowledge-quotient-framework/; CSV STT 2 — Wobi Connected Customer Data for Real-Time Recommendation (Wobi) — https://neo4j.com/blog/real-time-recommendations/powering-recommendations-graph-database-proven-business-benefits/

propertyRequirements.mandatoryRaw: productCode; name; productClassification; price; fee; versionNumber; status; effectiveFrom; effectiveTo

classes.name: product offer
classes.label: product offer
classes.definition: A sale-specific offer attached to exactly one BankingProduct, with price/discount/benefit, conditions and validity.

businessMetadata.purpose: Represents the concrete commercial proposition the AI Agent can surface for a product.

evidence.sourceQuote: Offer (thuộc product), giá/chiết khấu, ưu đãi, điều kiện bán offer, eligibility offer, hiệu lực, trạng thái, phiên bản.

modeling.decisionReason: Has independent lifecycle/version/status and is referenced by Product, Campaign, Rule, Segment/Need and Sales Script.
modeling.openQuestions: Can one Product have overlapping active offers? How is offer eligibility represented vs generic Rule?

fiboAlignment.definition: An offer-like expression to provide something, contingent on acceptance or other consideration.
fiboAlignment.reason: FIBO Offering is more general than BA Product Offer and is not constrained to one product, price/discount or catalog lifecycle. Reuse only as superclass.

classes.label: campaign

modeling.decisionReason: Independent identity, schedule/lifecycle, budget and links to Offer/Product/Segment/Need/Rule.
modeling.openQuestions: Are campaign target criteria only Segment/Need, or can a campaign target additional customer/context dimensions?

modeling.openQuestions: Does BA require a hierarchical taxonomy? If classification is a fixed enum only, demote this to Product.productClassification.
